endorsements.quote: Pharmacists or researchers should critically evaluate and verify the information provided by ChatGPT before making a final decision, and they should be responsible for the final decision ( Figure 4 ).

ChatGPT, while capable of addressing professional inquiries and providing recommendations, serves as an auxiliary decision support tool rather than a substitute for the professional knowledge of clinical pharmacists [ 51 ].

Piloting ChatGPT in select areas of the pharmacy, soliciting feedback from frontline staff, and iterating on the implementation plan based on real-world experiences can significantly mitigate challenges and optimize outcomes.
Medical professionals should participate in training and calibration of ChatGPT and regularly evaluate and verify its performance in medical applications.
Concurrently, pharmacy personnel are trained in the use of ChatGPT, emphasizing best practices and potential risks.
To ensure the widespread adoption of AI in health care, developing interfaces that seamlessly integrate AI technologies with existing hospital information systems is essential.

In terms of privacy and compliance, it is imperative that the use of ChatGPT adheres to data protection regulations such as HIPAA (Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act) and undergoes review by an ethics committee to prevent ethical issues.
When interacting with ChatGPT, sensitive information should be deidentified to protect patient privacy.

unlisted_practices: Obtain informed consent from patients before using ChatGPT.
Have pharmacists review ChatGPT-generated medication education and consultation content to ensure accuracy before it reaches patients.
Submit controversial prescriptions or medication orders flagged by AI to clinical pharmacists for manual review.
Conduct a needs assessment to determine the scope of assistance ChatGPT can provide before integration.
Regularly assess ChatGPT's performance, including accuracy and user satisfaction, and make improvements based on evaluation results.
Fine-tune and strengthen language model training on professional medical datasets to improve accuracy.
Governments and industry associations should establish innovation and regulatory frameworks for AI.
Establish clear policies and guidelines for AI use so all relevant personnel understand and comply with them.
Foster cross-disciplinary collaboration among pharmacy, IT, data science, and health care management for AI integration.
Do not use ChatGPT to write entire papers; use it only as an auxiliary tool and verify its output.
